question: What insurance must Ashworth maintain under its promotion agreement with Nantz Communications?
answer: Ashworth must maintain (i) advertising and product liability insurance with limits of at least $5,000,000, naming Nantz Communications and Nantz as insured parties and providing at least twenty (20) days written notice before any termination or material modification; and (ii) directors and officers liability insurance with limits of at least $25,000,000, naming Nantz as an insured party and also providing at least twenty (20) days written notice before any termination or material modification. [1]
